objective: Detailed Operation Evidence Contract. Complete the one-way VF→MES contract (tipa-assy-demo-v1 → v1.1) by additively projecting authoritative runtime/operation-execution evidence into MES-compatible ProjectedMessages via the existing M5 pipeline: (1) AP03 checklist evidence — mes.checklist_result (CHECKLIST_CONFIRMED) with item_id/required/completed, required_count, completed_count, status=confirmed, no quality disposition fabricated; (2) AP06 numerical measurement evidence — mes.measurement_result (MEASUREMENT_RESULT) for every R_U-V / R_V-W / R_W-U resistance measurement per attempt with value/unit/lower_limit/upper_limit/in_spec (inclusive limits), evidence_source=DEMO_SYNTHETIC, linked to execution_id/record_id/attempt_number; (3) AP08 (VISUAL_INSPECTION) and AP11 (FINAL_QC) structured inspection observations — extend mes.quality_result with observations[] (observation_id + result ok|anomaly) plus separate proposed_quality_result and proposed_quality_reason fields; observations must NOT be rewritten after the decision is recorded (per-attempt immutability). All evidence derives from authoritative runtime data; the bridge must NOT fabricate values. No MES implementation in this gate. Contract version v1.1 must be returned by /assy-demo/version and stamped on every message.
explicit_non_objectives: No MES implementation (this is VF→MES contract only)
No redesign of the observation pipeline core (envelope/point/service/router/policy/gateway)
No rewrite of the six-sub-line runtime/topology
No change to operation_execution.py or station_contracts.py

allowed_paths_additive_justified.reason: Per-attempt structured observation results and the machine proposal/reason are NOT exposed in a stable form: QualityRecord.checklist_items stores only observation-id strings (no result), and op.observations/op.proposed_quality_result are overwritten on every re-observation, so a retested attempt's NG evidence is lost. To satisfy the gate requirement that observations must not be rewritten after the decision is recorded, the immutable QualityRecord gains additive default-valued fields observations/proposed_quality_result/proposed_quality_reason frozen at decision time. No existing field is changed and no behavior is altered.

Single additive constructor call in _apply_quality_decision passes the already-observed op.observations/op.proposed_quality_result/op.proposed_quality_reason into the new QualityRecord fields. This is the only place the authoritative per-attempt observation/proposal exists at decision time. No transition logic, scheduling, or business behavior is changed.

required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/assembly/assy_mes_bridge.py (additive CHECKLIST_CONFIRMED + MEASUREMENT_RESULT facts, observations[]/proposed_quality_result/proposed_quality_reason on quality facts, contract v1.1)

AP03 checklist item ids and counts match DEMO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_IDS (demo_item_1..3, required, completed)
AP06 emits exactly three mes.measurement_result per attempt (R_U-V, R_V-W, R_W-U)
AP06 measurement carries value/unit/lower_limit/upper_limit/in_spec with inclusive limits
AP06 FAIL measurement (R_U-V=0.29 below lower limit) preserved after retest
AP06 measurement linked to quality attempt (execution_id/record_id/attempt_number)
AP08 observations + proposal are separate fields; NG attempt carries an anomaly observation
AP11 observations emitted on quality_result; not conflated with release or line-out
Contract version tipa-assy-demo-v1.1 on every message
Repeated poll produces no duplicate message keys
Reset produces a new run generation without reusing idempotency keys
Full VF test suite stays green
